leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply Ionic components to construct a user interface for displaying queued orders
Use Angular services to create a centralized data store for offline orders
Implement Capacitor Storage API to persist order data locally on the device
Execute conditional rendering to display appropriate UI states when offline
Define event handlers to capture new order submissions when network connectivity is unavailable
Construct data models with TypeScript interfaces to represent order structure
Utilize array methods to manage the queue by adding, removing, and retrieving orders
Apply Angular lifecycle hooks to initialize the offline queue when the component loads
Implement network status detection using Capacitor Network API to trigger offline mode
Use RxJS Observables to create reactive data streams for order queue updates
Execute synchronization logic to process queued orders when network connectivity is restored
Apply error handling to manage failed order submissions during offline operations
